messages:
maria: Quick weekly rollout update — soft freeze starts tomorrow 08:00 UTC for ~48h. Scope: infra-level changes, quant plugin updates, and schema/shard routing require explicit approval. :megaphone:

maria: High-level timeline (UTC):
```
Tomorrow 08:00 - Soft freeze ON
Day 1 09:00 - Canary batch A (5%)
Day 1 13:00 - Canary metrics review (eng + ops)
Day 2 08:00 - Canary batch B (25%)
Day 2 18:00 - Full rollout (if green)
```

aj: Ack. I'll hold all non-essential merges and throttle CI.

chen: Quick Q — are we temporarily shifting any SLOs to reduce false positives during the canary? We saw tail spikes last week.

leila: Ops note: We relaxed embeddings route SLO from 99.9% -> 99.8% for the duration of the freeze window to avoid noisy alerts. Tags: `release.train/embeddings-slo` on alerts.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall for the canary windows. Ping me for any latency/error spikes. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/dash/rollout-campaign-4087

deploy-bot: Canary job rc-4087 scheduled. batch A: 5% traffic -> 12 hosts.

deploy-bot: Canary initial metrics: QPS=420, p95=230ms, errors=0.02% (baseline).

maria: Reminder: schema or shard-routing changes are blocked during soft freeze unless approved via /release-exception with impact analysis and signoff from @maria + @leila. No implicit approvals.

aj: Noted. I'll only file exceptions for perf-critical work and will include benchmark diffs.

chen: For Dedicated customers, do we have the automatic fallback to smaller model if latency exceeds threshold? We should avoid customer-facing errors.

leila: Yes — smart routing policy `canary-fallback-v1` is active. If latency >300ms or errors >0.5% it will failover to the compatible smaller model and re-route traffic to dedicated capacity where configured.

ops-oncall: If KV cache pressure shows up, reduce batch size: `export BATCH_MAX=8` on the canary hosts (temp). I'll push a runbook note in #eng-oncall.

maria: Small ops ask — teams owning model infra, please surface any perf diffs by tagging `rollout-readout` in your PR and include perf numbers (p50/p95/p99 + mem). We want a concise post-freeze readout.

chen: Will do. Expecting some quantization delta; will attach eval set.

leila: Also FYI: tracing hooks are enabled for canary traffic (trace-id prefix `rc-4087`). Use the traces to correlate token-level latency.

ops-oncall: Logging note: added temporary sampling for debug spans at 1% to avoid log blast.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short readout summary Day 3 10:00 UTC. If you need immediate assistance during the window, @maria or @leila are the primary contacts. :white_check_mark:
